Write a function that takes in two lists and replaces the last element of the first list with the elements of the second list.

arguments.solution_code:
def replace_list(lst1, lst2):
    """Replace the last element of lst1 with all elements of lst2.

    If lst2 has one element, it replaces the last element directly.
    If lst2 has multiple elements, they are inserted in place of the last
    element of lst1.
    """
    if not lst1:
        return lst2[:]  # nothing to replace
    return lst1[:-1] + lst2
